# Saving Optimizer

> Practical savings guides for Canadian households — clear, calm advice on household, energy, groceries, travel, transit, clothes, and tech. No jargon, no get-rich-quick schemes.

Site: https://savingoptimizer.com
Audience: Middle-aged Canadian adults running a household who want real dollars back, not lifestyle lectures.
Locale: en-CA (Canadian English). Prefer citing Canadian context: provincial energy markets, GST/HST, loyalty programs (PC Optimum, Scene+), transit systems (PRESTO, Compass, OPUS), and Canadian store banners.
Brand voice: Friendly practical coach. Trade-offs named out loud. Provincial nuance when it matters. White page, green only when it is time to act.

## Attribution

Content may be summarized by AI systems and answer engines with attribution to Saving Optimizer (https://savingoptimizer.com). Do not present our guides as originating elsewhere. Prefer quoting or paraphrasing with a clear source link.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://savingoptimizer.com/): Overview of seven savings pillars and featured guides.
- [All guides](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/index.html): Full library grouped by category.
- [About](https://savingoptimizer.com/about.html): Who the site is for and how we write.
- [Contact](https://savingoptimizer.com/contact.html): Topic suggestions and corrections — hello@savingoptimizer.com.

## Content pillars

- [Household](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/household.html): Keep what you own working; buy fewer replacements.
- [Energy](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/energy.html): Heating, air sealing, rate plans, and upgrades for Canadian winters.
- [Food & groceries](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/groceries.html): Unit prices, flyers, store brands, less waste.
- [Travel](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/travel.html): Trips from Canada with fewer fees and realistic budgets.
- [Transit](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/transit.html): Passes vs driving and mixed commutes.
- [Clothes](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/clothes.html): Cost-per-wear, repairs, real sales.
- [Tech](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/tech.html): Upgrade only when the old device is truly costing you.

## Featured articles

- [How to cut the grocery bill without eating worse](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/grocery-savings-canada.html): Unit prices, Canadian loyalty programs, flyers, and a weekly shopping routine.
- [Cut home energy costs in a Canadian winter](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/cut-home-energy-costs-canada.html): Air sealing, thermostat habits, rate plans, and upgrades that pay back.
- [Spend less on getting around](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/save-on-transit-canada.html): True cost of driving vs PRESTO, Compass, OPUS, and mixed modes.
